note: Railyard app bootstrap re-download loop: after lyon/marseille/paris-ile-de-france re-released under new city codes (LYS->LSY, MRS->MAR, PAR->PRS, registry PRs #7142/#7144/#7146) to avoid colliding with the base game's new vanilla French cities, installed clients whose pinned old version wrote disk under the old code were silently dropped at startup and re-downloaded the pinned version on every launch (monorepo PR #615 has the fix). Old-version counters inflated from 2026-08-07. Allowance model: before each target's superseded_start (old version still latest) the baseline-window rate applies (window 2026-07-24 -> 2026-08-06, after the 07-20/21 release burst); from superseded_start on, organic old-version demand collapses to the superseded-peer rate, pooled from the yukina JP maps whose old versions were superseded the same week (all show ~0-2/day regardless of install base; the known-good reference). NEW-version traffic for lyon/marseille v1.0.2 is also loop-inflated (early updaters whose clients still held pre-merge manifests with the old code looped on the new asset; client manifest-cache staleness smeared this past the 2026-08-09 merge): adoption_targets attribute the excess over the peer-adoption curve (max per-day fraction of install base across adoption_peers, the same-week yukina updates). paris v1.0.5 sits inside the peer adoption envelope (0.31x base over 5 days, curve matching yukina-sendai) and is deliberately NOT targeted. incident_end stays null until the app release containing PR #615 has saturated.
